metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows easy exercises that may help relieve a backache in as little as 30 seconds.

These exercises target the main muscles often responsible for pain, tightness, and stiffness in the back.

Each exercise works a little differently. For the best results, try them all and use the ones that give you the most relief.

Watch now and feel your backache ease in seconds!
